Strategy Rules
Entry: BB Mean-Reversion — Enter when all three conditions align:
• Close price at or below Bollinger Band lower (20-period, 2 std)
• RSI(14) < 30 (deeply oversold)
• Williams %R < -80 (extreme bearish momentum)

Exit: Time-Stop 90d — Force exit after 90 trading days regardless of P/L.
This is the optimal exit confirmed by extensive backtesting (13 trades, 76.9% WR, Sharpe 12.39).

Slippage: 0.1% on entry/exit. Risk-free rate: 5%.
